messages:
sara_sec: Quick sync thread 1: we need a short ops handoff for the base-image rebuild and signing flow before Friday's audit. Key points: per-repo KMS keys, RBAC tighten, attest verification in admission, and compromise runbook.
ben_infra: I'll provision key templates and an IAM snippet. Prefer per-repo cryptoKey and a build SA with cryptoSigner only.
kai_build: CI flow: syft -> cosign attest+sign using KMS key -> push -> upload SBOM & attest to gs://artifacts-sbom -> emit audit event to logger-audit-prod.
alert-bot: vuln-scan: base-202407 flagged libcurl CVE-2024-XYZ severity: high.
toni_sre: Rekor: keep 6mo hot, cold-archive to GCS for 2y. Admission webhook should verify Rekor inclusion id and signer key id. If verification fails, add label "image:quarantine" and block rollout.
sara_sec: Action items:
- ben_infra: KMS templates + IAM JSON (ETA EOD).
- kai_build: CI snippet + example Rekor payload (ETA tomorrow).
- toni_sre: admission policy + Rekor retention plan (ETA EOD).
- sara_sec & ben_infra: draft key compromise runbook (revoke key, mark images suspect, trigger rebuilds, notify).
ben_infra: created ticket INFRA-11007 and attached preliminary IAM. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-11007
sara_sec: Thanks all. Meeting in 30 to finalize. If you can't make it, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
